fastest_rising.description: LibreCode - A Ollama cursor like coding / Reversing Interface
fastest_rising.readme_summary: A free, open-source AI-powered code editor built from the ground up with .NET 10 and Avalonia UI. Runs natively on Windows, Linux, and macOS -- no Electron, no web views, just fast native rendering.
